semiconductor_relevance: High — NNFC provides semiconductor manufacturing services and technology platforms, focusing on R&D and collaboration with academic and industrial partners.
summary: NNFC (National NanoFab Center) is a leading public institution in Korea that offers semiconductor technology services, specializing in silicon-based semiconductors, MEMS, and Nano-Bio fields. Established in 2004, it supports domestic industries and research institutions with advanced cleanroom infrastructure and various semiconductor manufacturing platforms.
capabilities: Semiconductor and display convergence technology platform

regional_presence.Korea: NNFC is affiliated with the Ministry of Science and ICT and focuses on supporting the domestic semiconductor industry.
